$comment: 3D decision matrix. When 3D is justified, what type, and what the rejection criteria are.

technology_selection.three_js: custom 3D scenes, custom camera, scroll integration, vanilla JS
technology_selection.r3f: React project where 3D integrates with React state
technology_selection.model_viewer: single model orbit+zoom, AR preview, fastest implementation
technology_selection.raw_webgl_webgpu: custom shader effects that Three.js cannot express

final_test: Remove the 3D. Replace with a single well-chosen photograph. If the page works just as well, 3D was not justified.
